svg.title: ContacTeam — A customer desk for sales teams

g.text: A customer desk for sales teams
Every customer arriving from WhatsApp, Instagram,
the website or ad forms becomes a single record and is
handed to a rep in turn. No customer is left hanging
and nobody gets called twice. Reps handle calls,
messages and outcomes on one screen, and carry on…
